title: atriplex hortensis subsp. nitens
intro: Atriplex hortensis subsp. nitens, commonly known as bright green orach, is a subspecies of the orach plant, belonging to the Amaranthaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Atriplex hortensis subsp. nitens include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
